== Notes ==
* Synergy with offensive [[spirit]]s summoned by [[binding ritual]]s, since spirits will gain health when attacking foes hexed with this spell.
* Foes attacking [[masterless minion]]s hexed with this spell will gain health. 
* Consider casting this to counter the damage from [[Afflicted Soul Explosion]] and/or [[Death Nova]].
